# error in cache key name

In Hook.php, method getAllHookIds, the `$cacheId` is wrong for `with aliases`. It is `'hook_idsbynamehook_idsbyname_withalias'` instead of `'hook_idsbyname_withalias'`.
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/32b958d86912b5ece2087e307dfc6aca9c7ba385/classes/Hook.php#L1223

The correct cache ids are 'hook_idsbyname' without aliases and 'hook_idsbyname_withalias' with, as ussed elsewhere, see https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/32b958d86912b5ece2087e307dfc6aca9c7ba385/classes/Hook.php#L126

## Attendu
The correct name is `'hook_idsbyname_withalias'`.

## Étapes
Look at the two lines. The error is obvious. https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/32b958d86912b5ece2087e307dfc6aca9c7ba385/classes/Hook.php#L1223
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/32b958d86912b5ece2087e307dfc6aca9c7ba385/classes/Hook.php#L126
